stem_md: $3x^2y\ln y\,dx+(2x^3+2y^3+3y^3\ln y)dy=0$ 的积分因子为（ ）
analysis_md:
$$
P(x,y)=3x^2y\ln y,\quad Q(x,y)=2x^3+2y^3+3y^3\ln y,
$$

$$
\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=3x^2\ln y-3x^2,
$$

$$
-\frac{1}{P}\left(\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}-\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}\right)=\frac{1-\ln y}{y\ln y},
$$

故积分因子为

$$
\mu(y)=e^{\int\frac{1-\ln y}{y\ln y}\,dy}=e^{\int\frac{1-\ln y}{\ln y}\,d\ln y}=\frac{\ln y}{y},
$$
